Gombe State Governor, Muhammadu Yahaya, on Tuesday sympathised with the families of Kabiru and Haruna, both of Dasan Yunusa town in Yamaltu-Deba Local Government Area of the state, following their deaths in a road accident. The two men were involved in a motorcycle accident involving a vehicle conveying the Gombe State Chairman of the All Progressives Congress, Mohammed Dantata Ndus, and the Director-General of the party’s 2027 Campaign Council, Malam Sa’adu Hassan. Our correspondent reports that Ndus and Hassan sustained injuries in the accident and are recuperating at the Federal Teaching Hospital, Gombe, where they were taken for medical attention after the midday incident. Speaking during a condolence visit to Dasan Yunusa, Yahaya urged the bereaved families to accept the loss and find strength in their faith. He said, “I am here together with my entourage because of the accident. We are just returning from Talasse. Unfortunately, two people died in the accident. It was an unavoidable incident. There is nothing we can do but to plead with the affected families. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources “It can happen to anybody. It is just for us to console ourselves. Nothing can be done for the deceased except prayers. May God give us the fortitude to bear the loss.” As a gesture of sympathy, the governor announced a donation of N5m to support the bereaved families and different groups in the community. He said, “I will be donating N1m each to the deceased families, the elderly, women and youths, and another N1m to the community.” The accident occurred on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, while the APC chieftains were travelling to participate in the party’s 2027 governorship campaign activities in Balanga North, Balanga Local Government Area. Preliminary reports indicated that the driver of the vehicle conveying the party officials swerved to avoid a motorcycle that suddenly appeared on the road, causing the vehicle to veer off the road. The Federal Road Safety Corps reportedly identified the vehicles involved as a Toyota Jeep and a Bajaj motorcycle. Its preliminary report recorded one death and six injuries, while the vehicles were reportedly handed over to the police for further investigation. Chima Azubuike
